label: CFRT ArcFlax 9 presentation describes participatory GIS
summary: An archived presentation titled “ESRI 2005 – Participatory GIS ArcFlax 9” credits Duane Wilkins at the Crown Forestry Rental Trust, describes ArcFlax 9 as participatory GIS for evidential work in a judicial inquiry, and identifies ArcReader 9.1. The deck records the presentation’s framing; it does not identify a regional edition or the exact contents of later DVDs.

sources.label: Duane Wilkins, “ESRI 2005 – Participatory GIS ArcFlax 9”, 43-slide presentation; Google Drive archive copy, accessed 12 October 2026 (access may be restricted)
